desc.BR_InsertionCinematic_Dropzone_Loop: Drop zone loop. InsertionCinematic_Loop turns into it; play it to skip ahead.
desc.BR_InsertionCinematic_Loop: Insertion one-shot that turns into the drop zone loop after a few seconds.
desc.BR_InsertionJump: One-shot for jumping out at insertion.
desc.BR_LastTwoSquads: One-shot, played when you are in the last two squads.
desc.BR_Loss_Early_Loop: Loop for being eliminated before the end of the round.
desc.BR_Loss_EndOfRound_Loop: Loop for losing at the end of the round in third place or worse.
desc.BR_Loss_SecondPlace_Loop: Loop for finishing the round in second place.
desc.BR_Pause: Pauses whatever BR music is playing.
desc.BRGauntlet_LobbyFilled: Plays when the lobby fills. Set BRGauntlet_LobbyTimerRemaining before playing it.
desc.BRGauntlet_WaitingForPlayers_Loop: Quiet loop while waiting for players in the lobby.
desc.BRGauntlet_LobbyTimerRemaining: Lobby countdown, 10 to 0, used by BRGauntlet_LobbyFilled. Set it once, then play that.
desc.Core_Deploy_Loop: Quiet, ambient loop, played while players are deploying.
desc.Core_EndOfRound_Loop: End-of-match loop. Core_IsWinning and Core_Sector pick the version.
desc.Core_LastPhaseBegin: One-shot track for the start of the last phase.
desc.Core_Overtime_Loop: Quiet, suspenseful loop for overtime, e.g. capturing a point in overtime.
desc.Core_PauseMenu_Loop: Quiet, ambient loop for the pause menu.
desc.Core_PhaseBegin: One-shot for the start of a phase. Core_IsWinning and Core_Sector pick the version.
desc.Core_PhaseEnded: One-shot for the end of a phase. Core_IsWinning and Core_Sector pick the version.
desc.Core_Stinger_RankUp: Sting played at the end of a match when you rank up.
desc.Core_IsWinning: 0 = losing, 1 = winning. Picks the version of PhaseBegin, PhaseEnded and EndOfRound.
desc.Core_PhaseUrgency: Above 0, end-of-phase tension music starts at once. Each whole number adds a layer.
desc.Core_Sector: 0 = no sectors (Conquest). 1 to 3 = that sector's music (Breakthrough).
desc.Core_Urgency: Above 0, end-of-round tension music starts at once. Each whole number adds a layer.
desc.Gauntlet_Loss_FinalMission_Loop: Loop for losing the final mission.
desc.Gauntlet_Loss_Loop: Loop for losing any mission except the final one.
desc.Gauntlet_MissionBriefing_Final: One-shot for the final mission briefing.
desc.Gauntlet_MissionBriefing_One: One-shot for the first mission briefing.
desc.Gauntlet_MissionBriefing_Three: One-shot for the third mission briefing.
desc.Gauntlet_MissionBriefing_Two: One-shot for the second mission briefing.
desc.Gauntlet_Pause: Pauses whatever Gauntlet music is playing.
desc.Gauntlet_Qualified_Loop: Loop for qualifying. Play Qualified_Outro next for a smooth ending.
desc.Gauntlet_Qualified_Outro: One-shot outro. Follows Qualified_Loop smoothly, or plays on its own.
desc.Gauntlet_Urgency_FinalMission: Long urgency one-shot for the final mission, 35 seconds.
desc.Radio_ClearQueue: Empties the queue. The only way to remove queued tracks.
desc.Radio_NextQueuedTrack: Skips to the next queued track.
desc.Radio_Play: Plays the queued tracks on the selected channel. An empty queue plays nothing.
desc.Radio_Biome: Which region's radio station. Only used on channel 4.
desc.Radio_Channel: Station: 0 Hip Hop, 1 Rock, 2 BF Themes, 3 Reggaeton, 4 by biome, 5 Classical, 6 Pop.
desc.Radio_ContinueQueueOnTrackEnd: 1 = play the next queued track when one ends. 0 = stop after each track.
desc.Radio_LoopQueuedTracks: 1 = start the queue over after the last track. 0 = stop at the end.
desc.Radio_QueueTrackNumber: Track to add, from 0. QUEUE TRACK adds it, then moves on to the next track.
